Stack Trace

The parsed error trace behind a disclosure (UC-CODE-02 AC-3/AC-4: every frame's file and line legible at phone width; the raw trace copies with one tap) — port-at-parity per the PRD verdict, mono frame list with expandable frames and horizontal scroll. Upstream part set at parity (Header/Error/ErrorType/ErrorMessage/Actions/CopyButton/ExpandButton/Content/Frames; trace/open/defaultOpen=false/onOpenChange/onFilePathClick): copy hands over the RAW trace, internal frames dim to text-muted-foreground/50 and vanish under showInternalFrames=false (the upstream trap), and the expand button is verified against source to be a PASSIVE rotating chevron — the header is the only toggle. Frames scroll RIGHT in a bounded host (max-h-64, the house form of the web's 400px inline bound); without onFilePathClick the file:line:col renders unpressable — disabled, never pretend.

  • v0.2.1
  • component

Install

npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/nativewind/stack-trace.json
npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/uniwind/stack-trace.json

Source

Props

NameTypeDefaultDescription
tracestring—The raw stack trace string, exactly as the runtime printed it.
openboolean | undefined—Controlled open state (uncontrolled unless provided). The web default: closed.
defaultOpenboolean | undefinedfalse—
onOpenChange((open: boolean) => void) | undefined——
onFilePathClick((filePath: string, line?: number, col?: number) => void) | undefined—Fired by a frame's file:line:col press. Absent → locations render unpressable.
childrenReact.ReactNode——

Theming

Themed via text-muted-foreground, border-border, bg-background, bg-muted, text-destructive, text-foreground, text-primary.
